entities.name: Márcia Fu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcia Regina Cunha, known as Marcia Fu, is a Brazilian female retired volleyball player. She participated with the Brazil women's national volleyball team at the 1988 Summer Olympics, 1992 Summer Olympics and 1996 Summer Olympics, winning the bronze medal at the 1996 Summer Olympics. She participated at the 1994 FIVB World Championship in Brazil.
